cases.name: Audrii Danielle Cunningham
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Audrii was an extraordinary child that touched the lives of everyone who she knew. She will be remembered for her radiant smile that filled every room she entered with joy. Audrii was a happy, loving child that enjoyed things like singing and dancing. She was an artist and loved to paint; some of her artwork hangs in her school at Creekside Elementary where she was a 5th grader. Audrii was a kind and compassionate soul, and an animal lover, especially to her cats and dogs. She touched so many lives, in her short 11 years on earth, of not only the people that knew and loved her but her entire community. She will always be remembered, and her memory will live on in the hearts of everyone."
cases.narrative: On 2/21/2024, her body was found in the Trinity River under US 59. Her cause of death was homicidal violence including blunt head trauma."

cases.name: Jasmine Marie Muldoon
cases.about: “She was quirky, amazing. Very funny,” Muldoon’s mom, Dewana Bowman, told KPRC.
cases.narrative: On 5/6/2024, Muldoon’s body was found in a wooded area, off U.S. Highway 59 just north of Livingston, TX.
